item.description: ### Fixed - **Perch notices a Claude session waiting at a prompt even when its hooks are not running.** Until now everything Perch knew about a Claude session came from its hooks. A session started without them, or one stopped at a prompt the hooks do not report, such as a sandbox request or an open dialog, looked idle or did not appear at all. Perch now also reads the status Claude Code keeps for each running session, so such a session shows as needing you, says what it is waiting on, and sends the usual alert. These prompts can only be answered at the terminal, or with `claude attach` for a background session, so there are no Allow and Deny buttons for them.
